*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [32:1920]
:INPUT ACCEPT [32:1920]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [1313:78740]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [1355:81688]
:CILIUM_OUTPUT_nat - [0:0]
:CILIUM_POST_nat - [0:0]
:CILIUM_PRE_nat - [0:0]
:DOCKER_OUTPUT - [0:0]
:DOCKER_POSTROUTING - [0:0]
:KUBE-KUBELET-CANARY - [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -m comment --comment "cilium-feeder: CILIUM_PRE_nat" -j CILIUM_PRE_nat
-A PREROUTING -d 192.168.5.2/32 -j DOCKER_OUTPUT
-A OUTPUT -m comment --comment "cilium-feeder: CILIUM_OUTPUT_nat" -j CILIUM_OUTPUT_nat
-A OUTPUT -d 192.168.5.2/32 -j DOCKER_OUTPUT
-A POSTROUTING -m comment --comment "cilium-feeder: CILIUM_POST_nat" -j CILIUM_POST_nat
-A POSTROUTING -d 192.168.5.2/32 -j DOCKER_POSTROUTING
-A DOCKER_OUTPUT -d 192.168.5.2/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 127.0.0.11:33625
-A DOCKER_OUTPUT -d 192.168.5.2/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 127.0.0.11:57897
-A DOCKER_POSTROUTING -s 127.0.0.11/32 -p tcp -m tcp --sport 33625 -j SNAT --to-source 192.168.5.2:53
-A DOCKER_POSTROUTING -s 127.0.0.11/32 -p udp -m udp --sport 57897 -j SNAT --to-source 192.168.5.2:53
COMMIT
